purpose: Design prototype only; no project API keys used
prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: background plate for an interactive miniature desert oasis garden design prototype. Create ONE exquisite wide 3:2 landscape raster image, high-end cozy miniature diorama game art, tactile hand-sculpted sand and sandstone with sophisticated soft global illumination, physically plausible contact shadows, refined warm sandy peach colors, subtle mint atmospheric distance. Camera fixed at elevated three-quarter view approximately 40 degrees, near-orthographic, the entire scene viewed slightly from above. A broad flat sandy clearing fills the lower 75 percent of frame, gently bounded by low softly weathered sandstone ledges and layered distant dunes along the upper edge; warm late-afternoon sunlight from upper left. Very subtle fine sand grain, tiny scattered pebbles and wind ripples confined mostly to the perimeter, detailed without noisy texture. Spacious inhabitable miniature world, delightful and high quality, NOT a flat vector illustration, NOT a giant empty colored polygon, NOT photographic harsh desert. Keep central and lower clearing genuinely uncluttered so independently movable props can be added by software. Ground continues to all four frame edges, no floating island edge. No characters, no trees, no furniture, no tents, no umbrellas, no pond, no lettering, no UI, no labels, no watermark. Make the perspective and lighting coherent with carefully rendered miniature 3D objects.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent-background game prop ATLAS for a miniature desert oasis garden prototype. ONE image with exactly FOUR columns and THREE rows of equally sized invisible cells, 12 isolated objects, one object centered inside each cell; maintain generous transparent gutters so each cell can be displayed as a CSS sprite without neighboring objects. Actual transparent alpha background, not a drawn checkerboard, not white. High-end polished cozy 3D miniature diorama art, detailed tactile materials, elevated three-quarter near-orthographic view at 40 degrees, warm sunlight from upper left; coherent scale and style across props. Objects fit entirely within their own cells including shadows; do not touch or cross cell borders. Order left to right, top to bottom: row 1 a single lush curved palm tree with textured brown trunk and jade fronds; a branching sculptural green cactus; a small cluster of weathered warm sandstone rocks; a shallow turquoise miniature pond enclosed by an irregular low pale stone rim. Row 2 a cream canvas triangular shade canopy supported by four wooden posts; a pair of terracotta and sage woven floor cushions; a low circular timber tea table with a tiny teapot; a small warm canvas A-frame camping tent with open entrance. Row 3 two short timber poles joined by a sagging strand of tiny warm fairy lights; a whimsical blank wooden directional sign; a rustic low wooden bench with woven seat; a terracotta planter of small desert flowers. These must be independently rendered objects on TRANSPARENCY, no shared ground, no scene behind, no continuous environment. Do not add captions, numbers, labels, borders, logos or additional props. Each cell contains a single intended grouped asset with faint tight contact shadow. Refined texture, rounded slightly whimsical silhouettes, adult-quality crafted miniature objects, NOT emoji, NOT clipart, NOT flat vector.
